rules.instagram: User approval, then scheduled publication only; profile/story link, not caption URL alone.
rules.pinterest: Topic-specific destination in the same language as the pin; confirm the actual published pin before recording success.
rules.google_ads: Keep existing spending limit. Common-root ads use language negotiation. Country-specific copy and links require separate reviewed campaign targeting.
rules.measurement: Compare sessions/users, engaged time, itinerary saves and partner clicks. A partner click is not a completed booking.
